entries.title: Tell Infinitary started by a command where your programs are
entries.body: When a command starts Infinitary with no window, it can now name a settings file that lists the folders where your programs are. Your crew finds them there, even on a computer nobody is logged in to. A mistake in the file stops the start and says what to fix.
entries.noPicture: The settings file is read by a command started in a terminal or at boot, with no change to the app's windows.
